annotations.text:
Why a flowchart and not a list.

A list implies you do 1, then 2, then 3, and arrive. This plan doesn't work like that — two of the three forks send you backwards, and that is the normal path, not the failure path. Drawing the loops is the honest version.

One thing changed from the app.

Its phase colours ran ember → lime → teal, and ember/lime are almost identical to a red-green colour-blind reader (ΔE 1.1). Swapping to ember → teal → violet → lime → sky clears every check, and it frees lime from also meaning "free".
These are static mockups — nothing here is wired up. The numbers are the sample plan's real ones, so the charts can be argued with rather than admired.
